<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;text-autospace:none"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">The development hereby permitted shall not
progress beyond completion of superstructure level until full details and
specifications of any plant and equipment associated with the air handling, and
ventilation system, and air source heat pumps (or other such similar
equipment), and details of mitigation and control of noise and vibration
emanating from such systems has been submitted to and approved in writing by
the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp; The
development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and
retained thereafter.<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">All Non-Road Mobile Machinery (NRMM) of net power of 37kW
and up to and including 560kW used during the course of the demolition, site
preparation and construction phases shall comply with the emission standards as
published on the NRMM Website (https://nrmm.london/). Unless it complies with
the standards set out on the website, no NRMM shall be on site, at any time,
whether in use or not, without the prior written consent of the local planning
authority. The developer shall keep an up to date list of all NRMM used during
the demolition, site preparation and construction phases of the development on
the online register at https:// nrmm.london/<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;
font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:Calibri;mso-fareast-theme-font:
minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:EN-US;mso-bidi-language:
AR-SA">No piling shall take place until a Piling Method Statement (detailing
the depth and type of any piling to be undertaken and the methodology by which
such piling will be carried out, including measures to prevent and minimise the
potential for damage to subsurface water infrastructure, and the programme for
the works) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning
Authority in consultation with Thames Water. Any piling must be undertaken in accordance
with the terms of the approved piling method statement</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;text-autospace:none"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">The development hereby approved shall not
progress beyond damp-proof course (DPC) level of Blocks A and B until a report
has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority
identifying those residential units within the development that require
mitigation of external noise and specifying the measures required to achieve
satisfactory internal noise levels. The report shall also include details of
the proposed ventilation strategy and measures to address overheating for the
identified units. The development shall thereafter be carried out in full
accordance with the approved report and permanently retained as such.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;text-autospace:none"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">Notwithstanding the approved plans, prior
to the commencement of any work above DPC level on Block C, revised plans
showing the removal of the first-floor terrace/amenity area shall be submitted
and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp; The development shall be carried out in
accordance with the approved details and thereafter retained.<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;
line-height:107%;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">A minimum of 10% of the
residential units across the development shall be built in accordance with
Building Regulation standard M4 (3) 'Wheelchair User Dwellings'.&nbsp; All other residential units in this
development, shall be built to Building Regulation Standard M4 (2) 'Accessible
and adaptable dwellings'. <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">The development shall
be thereafter retained to those standards</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:.75pt"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:
12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-ansi-language:EN-US;
mso-bidi-font-weight:bold;mso-bidi-font-style:italic">The development hereby
permitted shall not progress above ground until details of the levels of the
building(s), road(s) and footpath(s) in relation to the adjoining land and
highway(s), and any other changes proposed in the levels of the site, have been
submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority.</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:.75pt"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:
12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-ansi-language:EN-US;
mso-bidi-font-weight:bold;mso-bidi-font-style:italic"><br></span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">The development shall be
carried out in accordance with the approved details and thereafter
retained.</span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Prior to the first occupation of each building of the
development hereby approved, an updated Fire Strategy Statement (FSS) shall be
submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify">(<span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">a)
Following the demolition of the buildings but prior to the commencement of
building works, a site investigation shall be carried out by competent persons
to determine the nature and extent of any soil contamination present. The
investigation shall be carried out in accordance with the principles of BS
10175:2011 + A2:2017 and the Environment Agency's current Land Contamination
Risk Management Guidance. <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">A report shall be submitted to
the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing, that includes the results
of any research and analysis undertaken as well as an assessment of the risks
posed by any identified contamination. It shall include an appraisal of
remediation options should any contamination be found that presents an
unacceptable risk to any identified receptors.</span>&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;
line-height:107%;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">The development shall be
undertaken in accordance with any agreed remediation measures with the Local
Planning Authority.</span> <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p>









<span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:Calibri;mso-fareast-theme-font:minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:
EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:EN-US;mso-bidi-language:AR-SA">(b) Following
completion of measures identified in the approved remediation scheme a
verification report must be prepared, which shall be submitted and approved in
writing by the local planning authority</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Prior to the commencement of development (excluding
demolition, site clearance and below ground works), details of the proposed
green roof shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in
writing. <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">If within 5 years of the installation of a green roof, any
planting forming part of the green roof shall die, be removed, or become
seriously damaged or diseased, then this planting shall be replaced in the next
planting season with planting of a similar size and species.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">The green / blue roof shall be implemented in accordance
with the approved detail and maintained for the life of the development.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p>









</p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">&nbsp;</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Prior to above ground construction of the development
hereby permitted, scaled drawings (1:50) with details of the location and
dimensions of secure and covered cycle parking facilities shall be submitted to
and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The cycle parking
details shall demonstrate compliance with the London Cycling Design Standards
and must show a minimal of 30 Sheffield style standards in the finished design.<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;
font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:Calibri;mso-fareast-theme-font:
minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:EN-US;mso-bidi-language:
AR-SA;mso-bidi-font-weight:bold;mso-bidi-font-style:italic">Notwithstanding the
approved details and prior to the commencement of development, full details of
the permeable paving construction and details relating to the long-term
maintenance and management of the on-site drainage shall be submitted to and
approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be
implemented in accordance with the approved details and retained thereafter</span></p>

<p><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">The development of Block C shall not progress above
damp-proof course (DPC) level until full details of a scheme for the first- and
second-floor windows to prevent overlooking and loss of privacy to neighbouring
properties has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning
authority. The scheme shall include either obscure glazing and/or angled window
treatment as appropriate. The development shall thereafter be carried out in
full accordance with the approved details and permanently retained as such</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;text-autospace:none"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">The development hereby approved shall not be
occupied until a scheme for the hard and soft landscaping of the development,
to include details of the planting, hard surfacing materials, raised planters,
external seating and boundary treatment has been submitted to the Local
Planning Authority in writing to be agreed.&nbsp;
The Hard and soft Landscape proposal shall include details (but not be
limited to) to the following: &nbsp;<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;text-autospace:none"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;text-autospace:none"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">(a)Soft landscaping works shall include:
planting plans (at a scale not less than 1:100), written specification of
planting and cultivation works to be undertaken and schedules of plants, noting
species, plant sizes and proposed numbers / densities and an implementation
programme. <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;text-autospace:none"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;text-autospace:none"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">(b)</span><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif"> </span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">Details of all hard surfacing materials (including internal road
surfacing, parking bays, pavements and footpaths), </span><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">furniture, boundary treatment, natural
type play equipment, specification for the proposed supports and fixings for
plants, pergolas and climbing plant frames</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">, plant screens </span><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">including proposed material and source
/manufacturer and irrigation for plants and detailed drawings of such; for all
communal areas</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">. <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;text-autospace:none"><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;text-autospace:none"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">(c)Full scale metric cross sections and
elevations for all communal amenity and play spaces (at a scale of not less
than 1:100) fully dimensioned.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;text-autospace:none"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;text-autospace:none"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">(d) Detailed drawings (at a scale of not
less than 1:100), and a schedule and </span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">specification of
play equipment, including natural type of play equipment, climbing equipment,
including specification of the surface treatment within the play areas;</span><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;text-autospace:none"><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">&nbsp;</span></p><p>



















<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">The
development shall be carried out in accordance with the scheme so agreed and
shall be retained as such thereafter</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;text-autospace:none"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">The development hereby approved shall not
be occupied until a scheme for the on-going management and maintenance of the
soft landscaping within the development, to include a landscape management
plan, including long term design objectives, management responsibilities and
maintenance schedules for a minimum period of 5 years for all landscape areas,
and details of irrigation arrangements and planters, has been submitted to the
Local Planning Authority in writing to be agreed. <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;text-autospace:none"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">&nbsp;</span></p><p>



<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">The
development shall be carried out in accordance with the scheme so agreed and
shall be retained as such thereafter.&nbsp;</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">All planting including tree planting, seeding, or turfing
comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out prior to
first occupation of the development hereby permitted or the substantial
completion of the development, whichever is the sooner. Any trees, hedgerows or
shrubs forming part of the approved landscaping scheme which within a period of
five years from the occupation or substantial completion of the development
die, are removed or become<o:p></o:p></span></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">seriously damaged or diseased shall be replaced in the next
planting season with others of similar size and species, unless the Local
Planning Authority gives written consent to any variation.<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Prior to first occupation of the development hereby
permitted, evidence shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for
approval in writing validating the measures at the as-built stage to
demonstrate that the stated Urban Greening Factor of at least 0.35 has been
achieved.<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;
font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:Calibri;mso-fareast-theme-font:
minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:EN-US;mso-bidi-language:
AR-SA">Prior to the first occupation of either the residential or commercial
development hereby approved, evidence of certification of Secure by Design
Accreditation for both the residential and commercial development shall be
submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing for approval before any
part of the development is occupied or used. The development shall only be
completed and operated in accordance with any approval</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;
font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:Calibri;mso-fareast-theme-font:
minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:EN-US;mso-bidi-language:
AR-SA">Prior to first occupation of the development, confirmation to
demonstrate that the relevant building has been designed so that mains water
consumption does not exceed a target of 105 litres or less per person per day
for the residential elements shall be submitted to and approved in writing by
the Local Planning Authority</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Prior to the first commercial operation or occupation of
the Block B Residential units, which ever is first,&nbsp; a scheme of sound insulation proving that habitable
rooms within the development sharing a party ceiling/floor element with
commercial premises have been designed and constructed to provide reasonable
resistance to the transmission of sound from the commercial premises shall be
submitted and approved in writing by the local planning authority.&nbsp;&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Prior to the first occupation of development and
notwithstanding the approved documents below, <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">The Energy Statement (Rev 6) <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Proposed Overheating Changes mark-up (prepared by CPS<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">Scenario 1 - Approved Doc O 2021
Compliance Report No Cooling; </span><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:
107%;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-bidi-font-weight:bold"><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">Scenario 2A - Approved Doc O 2021
Compliance Report DSY1 Weather File; </span><span style="font-size:12.0pt;
line-height:107%;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-bidi-font-weight:bold"><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">Scenario 2B - Approved Doc O 2021
Compliance Report DSY2 Weather File; </span><span style="font-size:12.0pt;
line-height:107%;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-bidi-font-weight:bold"><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">Scenario 2C - Approved Doc O 2021

line-height:107%;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-bidi-font-weight:bold"><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">A final Overheating Mitigation Strategy capable of complying

will be implemented to minimise overheating risk.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">&nbsp;</span></p><p>





















</p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">The development shall be carried out in accordance with the
approved Strategy, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning
authority.<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">In the event that any E class use permitted within Block B
is occupied by a business that makes use of a commercial kitchen, details of
the extract ventilation system and odour control equipment for the commercial
kitchen, including all details of any external or internal ducting, must be
submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing. The approved
equipment shall be installed prior to the commencement of any use of the
commercial kitchen and the development shall thereafter be operated at all
times during the operating hours of the use and maintained in accordance with
the manufacturer's instructions.<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;
font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:Calibri;mso-fareast-theme-font:
minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:EN-US;mso-bidi-language:
AR-SA">In the event and prior to the first operational use of any business
operation within sub-parts d) Indoor sport and recreation (not swimming pools,

permitted, full written details of the access arrangements and predicted (if
not possible to verify exact numbers of patrons) customer numbers shall be
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning authority</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Block A and B hereby permitted shall not be occupied until
a verification noise assessment demonstrating compliance with relevant noise

insulation scheme pursuant to condition 21 has been submitted and approved in
writing by the local planning authority. <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">&nbsp;</span></p><p>



</p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Any necessary sound mitigation and insulation measures
shall thereafter be retained unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local
Planning Authority.&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;
line-height:107%;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Any contamination that is
found during the course of construction of the development hereby permitted
that was not previously identified shall be reported immediately to the local
planning authority. Development on the part of the site affected shall be
suspended until a risk assessment has been carried out and submitted to and
approved in writing by the local planning authority. Where unacceptable risks
are found, the development [or relevant phase of development] shall not resume
or continue until remediation and verification schemes have been carried out in
accordance with details that shall first have been submitted to and approved in
writing by the local planning authority.</span></p>

description:
Demolition of the existing building and redevelopment of the
site comprising the erection of three blocks from 3 to 9 storeys to include
residential (Class C3) units and flexible commercial (Class E) floorspace,
together with a landscaped podium, internal courtyard with disabled car
parking, cycle parking, plant and associated works.
